notes.notes:
This is a small update to fix a kinda-big bug!
[list]
[*]Fixed the ranger equipment generation bug in which new equipment stats would rise faster and faster.

notes.title: First Update is now live!
notes.notes:
This update fixes a few tiny problems to improve your experience. Here's the full changelog:
[list]
[*]Fixed a typo in Mord's library entry description.
[*]Fixed a grammatical error in the Common Heart item description.
[*]Not showing "died in" when beating the game anymore.
[*]Fixed spawn of two bosses that sometimes didn't appear and required re-entering their room.
[*]Tutorial now fades correctly when in-game.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Just released!
notes.notes:
Just flipped the switch and in a few minutes the game will be live in the store!

Thank you guys for the support that you've shown during this time. Mac was dropped but if there's enough interest in it I'll continue working on fixing it. :)

That said, enjoy! Be sure to point to any bug or unbalance you see in the game, as this has much content and I only have a single pair of eyes (and not very good ones, according to the doctor!) and I'll patch it up as soon as possible.

THANK YOU!

notes.title: On MacOS problems
notes.notes:
So, that's it. I've been working hard to fix the MacOS X version, to no avail. The steam staff have been kind enough to provide me some info to point me in the right track with this issue, but there doesn't appear to be any source I can track.

I'm asking: How many of you are mainly MacOS users for gaming? How many of you wouldn't be able to play if the game is only out for Windows and Linux?
I don't discard publishing the MacOS version in the future if a fix is found, but most likely, the game will launch for the two working platforms during this week.

Keep in mind, I'm a lone developer that worked on this game on his spare time for more than two years, and I'm seeing the code that runs smoothly in the editor crush my hard work and dreams, and that I'm with you guys if you think it's unfair to promise a thing and then not be able to hold it 100%.

I'm sorry and listening to suggestions, too.

notes.title: Sadly, there'll be a delay
notes.notes:
Hello all. I know most of you will be angry at this, and trust me when I say I'm the angriest.
Steam is being way slower than I expected in the review proccesses and I cannot determine when the game will be for sale, even if it's for all intents finished. I'm terribly sorry about this. Please be patient.
